description: Medical device company developing the eShunt System — endovascular CSF diversion for normal pressure hydrocephalus (NPH). The eShunt creates a shunt between the subarachnoid space and the venous system via the dural venous sinus (sigmoid sinus).
funding: $85M Series C (June 2026), J&J Innovation and Medtronic participated
key_product: eShunt System — endovascularly implantable CSF shunt + delivery components
clinical_status: STRIDE pivotal trial enrollment completed, PMA pathway, FDA Breakthrough Device Designation
key_technical_features: endovascular delivery of CSF shunt via catheter
shunt creates fistula between subarachnoid space and venous system
minimally invasive approach to hydrocephalus treatment
flow regulation between CSF and venous blood
